operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case column names: 'Height', 'Prominence', 'Range', 'Country' — must be double-quoted verbatim; case-insensitive lookup needed.
Table/column names are plain ASCII, no spaces; but 'Range' is a SQL keyword-ish name and must be quoted.
All tables tiny (mountain=23, camera_lens=11, photos=10 rows) — no huge-table sampling path exercised here.
All declared types are INT/REAL/TEXT; no Date/Time/Bool/Bit/Year dispatch, no crash-fallback types.
No NOT NULL constraints (notnull=0 everywhere) despite 0.0 null_rate in original — TS may emit NULLs and inserts will succeed.
PKs are single-column 'id' on all three tables; no composite keys, no self-FKs.
FKs photos.camera_lens_id->camera_lens.id and photos.mountain_id->mountain.id both resolve to existing unique parents.
Storage classes match declared types everywhere (integer/real/text); no contradictions.
photos.camera_lens_id has only 5 distinct values over 10 rows (duplicates); mountain_id 6 distinct — FK fan-out is real.
mountain.Height has 22 distinct over 23 rows (one duplicate); Prominence 21 distinct — ties exist in original.
camera_lens.name contains 'f/8.0', 'f /1.4' with slashes/spaces and trailing space — string fuzzer will contaminate these.
photos.color has only 2 distinct values ('RBG','Black/White') — very low cardinality enum-like column.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on INT id columns: scale=0, range [-1,1], int perturbation +-1/+-2 — will produce ids like 0,-1,2 colliding with PK dedup.
Number fuzzer on REAL Height/Prominence/focal_length_mm/max_aperture: scale=0 default (no args in type), range [-1,1] floats — implausible vs real 1.2..4260, likely FN driver for range predicates.
String fuzzer on name/brand/Range/Country/color: charset a-zA-Z0-9() length 0..20, 50% contaminate — will not reproduce 'Ethiopia','Morocco' etc.; literal pool from train SQL may inject some.
String fuzzer on camera_lens.name with '%' handling irrelevant (no % in samples) but int-like substrings absent — no +-1 variants.
FK fill: photos.camera_lens_id/mountain_id drawn with replacement from parent final id column — after PK dedup parent ids are small ints, so FK values plausible-ish but may be NULL if parent empty.
PK dedup on 'id' will drop many rows since Number fuzzer range [-1,1] yields few distinct ints — table sizes collapse, likely FP source (missing rows/ties).
No unique non-PK columns, so drop_unique_duplicates is a no-op here.
choose_table_sizes: tiny tables (<=2500 cap) — level-based sizing gives mountain/camera_lens/photos small counts; rand_lin gives 30..230.
Low-cardinality color (2 values) and Country (5) — String fuzzer will not preserve enum structure, driving FN on equality/IN predicates.
Ties in Height/Prominence (duplicates) — Number fuzzer's uniform draws rarely reproduce ties, FP on ORDER BY/top-k or COUNT DISTINCT.
No Date/Time columns, so Date/Time fuzzers unused; no checked columns so p stays 0.2 (or 0 w.p. 0.3).
